scope: Two previously unused 2019 Wizards War of the Spark: Ravnica chapters: bounded Rat-narrated event order only. Neither publication order nor shared characters creates an edge to the existing Y/Azorius/Amonkhet chronology ledgers.

strands.title: The Path to Opulent — Kaya, Teyo and Rat encounter Domri's defenders
strands.limitation: Rat's remembered encounter and interpretation of the battle; Kaya's intent to summon the Orzhov is not evidence that the entire guild joined. Domri's in-scene conduct is not a claim to current Gruul leadership.

events.label: Rat mourns Hekara amid the invasion
Kaya invites Rat and Teyo to accompany her
The trio travel toward Orzhova to seek Orzhov aid
Domri's Gruul warriors attack the Eternals behind the trapped trio
The travelling group encounters Simic and Izzet forces fighting Eternals

edges.quote: Kaya turned to Teyo and me and said
edges.note: Rat recounts the immediately preceding grief before Kaya asks them to go with her; no exact elapsed time.

edges.quote: Mistress Kaya was trying to get to Orzhova to summon her guild into battle.
edges.note: Kaya's declared purpose precedes the trio's narrated journey; the attempt is not proof of successful recruitment.
Domri's group intervenes after the travelers become trapped by Eternals on their Orzhova route.

edges.quote: We soon ran into a phalanx of Eternals
edges.note: Rat describes travelling with the Gruul group afterward and then meeting Simic/Izzet fighters.

strands.title: Desperate Operatives — the four-guild mission, Vraska and evacuation
strands.limitation: Rat narrates guild recruitment and rescue amid the war; Vraska's return and aid are not a current-leadership verdict, and her alleged betrayal is not resolved in this sequence. No other war front or date is implied.

events.label: Ral and Jace task Kaya with bringing four guilds to Operation Desperation
Kaya petitions Emmara and the Selesnya leadership for cooperation
Rat urges Borborygmos and Gan Shokta to unite the Gruul
Vraska returns and claims her Golgari throne
Vraska's party helps Ajani evacuate people into Golgari tunnels

edges.quote: Our first stop would be Selesnya
edges.note: The mission assignment explicitly precedes the first Selesnya visit in this narrator's account.

edges.quote: This final tunnel soon opened up onto Skarrg
edges.note: After the Selesnya encounter, Rat guides the group to the Gruul meeting place.
Rat counts the preceding recruiting attempts before recounting Vraska's later Golgari return; this is an account-local ordering only.

edges.quote: Bring everyone down. The Golgari will keep them safe.
edges.note: Vraska's aid to the trapped evacuees follows her documented return; no current trust or leadership assertion.
